title.zh: 将孔波斯特拉谷省Maragusan的Paloc描笼涯Paloc中学改设为Paloc国立中学，并为此拨款及为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Paloc Barangay High School in Barangay Paloc, Maragusan, Compostela Valley Province Into the Paloc National High School, Providing Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Converting the Paloc Barangay High School in Barangay Paloc, Maragusan, Compostela Valley Province Into the Paloc National High School, Providing Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Paloc Barangay thành Trường Trung học Paloc Quốc gia tại Barangay Paloc, Đô thị Maragusan, Tỉnh Compostela Valley Province, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này, và cho các mục đích khác
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Paloc Barangay เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Paloc แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ Paloc เทศบาล Maragusan จังหวัด Compostela Valley Province และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้ และเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์อื่น
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Sekolah Menengah Paloc Barangay menjadi Sekolah Menengah Paloc Nasional di Barangay Paloc, Kotamadya Maragusan, Provinsi Compostela Valley Province, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu, dan untuk tujuan lain
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Paloc Barangay kepada Sekolah Menengah Paloc Kebangsaan di Barangay Paloc, Perbandaran Maragusan, Wilayah Compostela Valley Province, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu, dan untuk tujuan lain

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8922_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Paloc Barangay High School in Barangay Paloc, Municipality of Maragusan, Compostela Valley Province is hereby nationalized to be known as the Paloc National High School.
All personnel, records, equipment, buildings, facilities and other properties of the Paloc Barangay High School are hereby transferred to the Paloc National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
